title: HB 1878 (2022) — Strict photo ID plus in-person absentee voting, drop-box ban, paper ballots, etc.
operative_text:
Photo ID: Voters casting absentee ballots in person would be required to present photo identification.
Provisional ballot without ID: A voter without the required photo identification would be permitted to vote by provisional ballot
Repeal of non-photo documents (student ID, voter card, utility bill, bank statement): [paraphrase, democracydocket]
Two weeks in-person absentee voting tied to ID law validity: [paraphrase, democracydocket]
Paper ballot official: Beginning January 1, 2023, the official ballot shall be a paper ballot that is hand-marked by the voter.
DRE ban after 2024-01-01 except accessibility: equipment that is designed for accessibility
Ban on private donations to election administrators; SoS may withhold funds; cybersecurity review every two years: [paraphrase]
Voter registration solicitors unpaid, >10 must register with SoS: [paraphrase]
No one may ask voters whether they want an absentee application: [paraphrase]
Drop boxes banned: [paraphrase; also says bans drop boxes]
Presidential primary replaced with caucus: [paraphrase, democracydocket; NOT corroborated, check enrolled text]
